name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: State-directed Russian operations executing physical maritime drone attacks against commercial vessels in Romanian and Bulgarian waters, kinetic missile strikes on Kyiv heating grids, and rapid construction of Geran-5 launch bases in Rostov.

name: Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Threat actor UTA0576 and broader opportunists targeting perimeter VPNs via CVE-2026-104935 to bypass authentication and gain root persistence, triggering alerts from CISA and NBSZ NKI.

name: DPRK Remote Worker Infiltration (Operation Lonestar Roundup)
summary: Coordinated illicit IT worker laptop rings funneled through stolen US citizen identities to extract tech salaries for Pyongyang's defense complex.

name: Commercial BMS and Cold-Chain Disruption Campaign
summary: Targeted manipulation of retail food networks expanding from Danfoss controllers to Copeland and Dixell platforms, triggering food spoilage and physical fires across ~700 French stores.

name: AdFection Mercenary Spyware Campaign
summary: Zero-click targeted ad campaigns facilitated by ad broker Discover-Tech dropping Candiru spyware onto media, government, and international agency devices upon iframe render.

name: Storm-2990 Global Phishing Kit Syndicate
summary: Chinese-speaking developer syndicate selling phishing tools (Iron Man, CoGUI, Haozi) via YAM Store, responsible for over 1 billion malicious credential-harvesting messages.

name: n0n Maritime and Logistics Extortion Wave
summary: Data-theft extortion wave targeting 38 global shipping terminals and logistics companies via an exposed shared application, leaking proprietary EDI operational streams.
